newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zellweger Luwa sees higher 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: Zellweger Luwa sees higher 1997 profit.

text.p: Diversified industrial group Zellweger Luwa AG said it was confident about the current year and expects a significant rise in profit and sales as long as there is no substantial change in conditions.
Zellweger Luwa also said in a letter to shareholders that group orders in the first two months were signficantly above last year in some areas.
"Even though forecasts are difficult after only three months, the board of directors and management are confident for the current year," Zellweger said.
There are signs of a certain recovery in the textile business, but this still has to be confirmed in coming months, it added.
The company also said integration of companies acquired last year was proceeding according to expectations.
Zellweger Luwa continues to focus on its cost situation and measures begun in 1996 at the Uster site will have a positive effect during the current year, the company added.
Zellweger Luwa employs around 6,200 people and is active in textile electronics, environmental monitoring, air and climate control, and electronic installation and network engineering.
